maddeler.e:
ننعصر (form VII)
# نَنْعَصِرُ (nanʕaṣiru) /nan.ʕa.sˤi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْعَصَرَ (inʕaṣara)
# نَنْعَصِرَ (nanʕaṣira) /nan.ʕa.sˤi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْعَصَرَ (inʕaṣara)
# نَنْعَصِرْ (nanʕaṣir) /nan.ʕa.sˤir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْعَصَرَ (inʕaṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
